notes.title: 💥 NipoBox Publisher Sale Starts NOW 💥
notes.content:
Hey, everyone!

September is here, and so are the amazing discounts! From September 17 to 24, the NipoBox Publisher Sale is live — get up to 85% OFF on all our games on Steam! Don't miss out! 🥳


🚨 Sale Duration: September 17rd – September 24th 🚨



NipoBox Publisher Sale Page 🙌


Fill your library now! 👇
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37489842/a8a1f27471a649cc83724fcf3672bc2f0ecd41db.png"]


CRUSHED - 85% OFF!


[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1355780/Crushed/"][/dynamiclink]

Crushed — is an Singleplayer and Multiplayer First-Person Survival Sandbox in an Open World! Challenge the wild and be ready to survive in harsh conditions. Explore the world, get resources, cook food, build a house, farm, hunt, and enjoy nature.


THE RED EXILE - 80% OFF!


[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1751890/The_Red_Exile_Survival_Horror/"][/dynamiclink]

The Red Exile is a Survival Horror game with procedural level generation, perks, and an AI-controlled Killer.


AWAY - 100% OFF!


[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/757910/Away/"][/dynamiclink]

Away — is a short game telling about the hero's death experience, performed in a gloomy black and white style.


KIKI - 60% OFF!


[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2142680/Kiki/"][/dynamiclink]

A vibrant platformer with unique graphics and catchy chiptune soundtrack! Dodge treacherous traps and obstacles, overcome only by your agility and quick reflexes. Don’t miss the chance to test your abilities and become a true master of jumping! 🏃‍♀️


REDEX - 60% OFF


[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1460250/RedEx/"][/dynamiclink]

RedEx is a 2D shooter with Tower Defence mechanics, with a minimalist pixel art stile. You are to fight against mercenaries of underground smuggling organization which pretends to be a logistic corporation called RedExpress.


SPELLAGIS - 35% OFF


[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2972090/Spellagis/"][/dynamiclink]

Spellagis is an arena-shooter and roguelite hybrid. Brave mages unite to prevent darkness and restore balance. By combining knowledge and artifacts, they engage in a battle where every step towards victory is deceptive and dangerous.


KNIGHT'S NIGHT! - 30% OFF!


[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3317530/Knights_Night/"][/dynamiclink]

Knight's Night! — is a retro-style 1-bit platformer. Collect items, unlock new abilities, and make your way into the evil wizard's castle to save the kingdom!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37489842/a8a1f27471a649cc83724fcf3672bc2f0ecd41db.png"]


Cheers, NipoBox team!

notes.title: Achievements and other gizmos! 🎉🎊
notes.content:
[code] The update is already available for download. You may need to restart Steam. Enjoy the game! [/code]

The first update is available. This time we have added:


 Added 10 achievements.
 The last used device is now shown in the control prompts. If you have connected a gamepad, there will be prompts with gamepad buttons, and vice versa. Works for devices: Keyboard, PlayStation gamepads, Xbox gamepads.
 Disabled mouse control in main menu and pause menu.
 Chapter covers.
 Fixes in main menu.
